implemented.singleWriterPolicy: One editable tab using browser Web Locks; second tab is read-only until close/retry. Unsupported capability fails closed.
implemented.pendingVerifiedAdCredits: Stored separately from active pool; credited when space opens, without another ad. Completed quota counted once.
implemented.attemptEntitlement: Unlimited at attempt registration survives expiry and reload. Legacy missing registration captures only currently verifiable entitlement.
implemented.atomicFailurePolicy: Game, variant selection, life, test wallet and provider outcome commit in one localStorage value. Canonical failure rolls back engine replay and transient UI; mirror failure cannot undo committed canonical outcome.
implemented.dedupPolicy: Exact legacy identity tombstones retained; authenticated provider sequence ranges compacted. No arbitrary identity eviction or gameplay-capacity threshold.

openValidation: Physical iPhone and WebKit/iOS Safari were not tested.
No C# LifeManager implementation or life parity harness is claimed. The gameplay C# PR is independent of this branch.
knownLimits: Arbitrary legacy identity tombstones consume finite local storage; physical quota can still reject a transaction safely. Rich rows are bounded at128.

Completed but not yet durably saved test receipt can retry in the live tab. Persistent storage failure followed by browser termination cannot guarantee the new local receipt; production provider must support durable redelivery.
A single writable tab per origin is intentional; this does not provide simultaneously editable same-profile tabs.
Device clock and development receipts are not trusted payment/ad validation.
Old v1 attempts did not record historical unlimited entitlement; migration does not invent an expired entitlement.
